text: A single point in time RD design anchored to March 30, 2012 is inadequate on its own because advisers could and did register before the deadline, funds near the $150 million threshold could choose between registered adviser and exempt reporting adviser status, and self-reported Morningstar AUM is not calculated the same way as the SEC's RAUM.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Barbara Luppi, Sandra Paterlini, Did the Dodd-Frank Act Impact Private Fund Performance  – Evidence from 2010 – 2015 (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2816408
